from pathlib import Path
import re, subprocess, sys
files = subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','*.md'], text=True).splitlines()
missing=[]
pat=re.compile(r'\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)')
for name in files:
    p=Path(name); text=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
    for raw in pat.findall(text):
        target=raw.split('#',1)[0].strip()
        if not target or target.startswith(('http://','https://','mailto:')): continue
        target=target.split(' ',1)[0]
        if not (p.parent/target).resolve().exists(): missing.append(f'{name}: {raw}')
if missing:
    print('Missing local markdown links:'); print('\n'.join(missing)); sys.exit(1)
print(f'Local markdown links OK across {len(files)} tracked markdown files')
